x.text:
Bayhaven is playable.

Play the skeleton build in your browser, phones included: https://fablestar.games/play/

Everything Fable 5.2 built today:
- drive and drift 3.2 km of beachfront
- 14 vehicles: a city bus, a scooter, a motorcycle, a golf cart, a lowrider that hops
- traffic that stops at red lights
- get out on foot and steal a car from traffic
- people on every sidewalk, and the Flamingo Flash Mob on the beach at sunset

It's rough and early, and all of it was written by an AI, live. It gets better every day until GTA 6 drops.

Keys: WASD to drive, Space to drift, F to get out or steal
